title: New Product Development: Automotive Aftermarket Product Development Option

program.section_heading: New Product Development: Automotive Aftermarket Product Development Option (A.S.)
outcomes: Students take a product through the stages of new products development.
Students design products for OEM and aftermarket automotive or autobody products.
Students evaluate the feasibility of the rapid prototyping products of their choice.
Students produce a cost-effective plan for an automation product of choice.
Students produce portfolio for a new design.
Students select a plan for manufacturing and procurement.

notes: The 'Total Units 16-17' line is the only total printed; it is recorded both as the program total and as the stated total of the single Program Requirements block.
The range 3.0-4.0 is printed once beside the ENGT 137 / ENGT 131 / ENGT 259 choice; no individual units are printed for ENGT 131 or ENGT 259, so their units are left null.
The degree requirements refer only to 'the general education requirements' without naming a specific pattern (CSU GE, IGETC, Cal-GETC, local GE), so ge_pattern is null.
Recommended Courses list (MTT 278, WELD 130, WMT 111L) is not part of the required total and is not recorded as a block. WELD 130 is not on the closed list.
Catalog prints NPD 103 as 'Tooling and Materials for New Product Development', while the closed list titles it 'Advanced Tooling and Materials for New Product Development'.
Catalog prints AUTO 100 as 'Automotive Maintenance and Operation'; closed list title is 'Auto Maint And Operation'.
